title: Improved constant factors for qubitized Hamiltonian simulation
summary: Quantum signal processing (QSP) serves as the asymptotically optimal technique for Hamiltonian simulation on a quantum computer. By approximating the time evolution operator via the Jacobi-Anger expansion, the Hamiltonian simulation problem reduces to a problem in polynomial approximation theory: find a sufficient degree-$d$ polynomial series to approximate $e^{-iτx}$ on $[-1,1]$ within error $ε$.
